title: Turkey pitta salad
summary: Turkey pitta salad is a mediterranean dinner built around turkey breast steaks and wholemeal pitta breads, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat turkey breast steaks dry and season it. Prep wholemeal pitta breads and cucumber for Turkey pitta salad so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook turkey breast steaks on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook wholemeal pitta breads and cucumber in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey pitta salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice turkey breast steaks and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the pittas, simmered in salted water until tender.
